overview_description.description: Sologenic is a blockchain ecosystem built on the XRP Ledger that enables users to trade tokenized stocks, ETFs, commodities, and crypto assets. It combines decentralized finance tools with a DEX, NFT marketplace, and the SOLO token, aiming to connect traditional financial markets with blockchain technology for fast, low-cost global trading. It also focuses on improving liquidity and accessibility for real-world assets through decentralized infrastructure.
